proposals.title: Reusable workflow synthesis + skill compiler
proposals.evidence: Gen2 benchmark reduced the mechanical-call proxy from 44 to 12 (0.727 reduction), but still required 12 separate Code Mode runs; observed Code Mode runs=18, steps=38.
proposals.expected_benefit: Turn successful audited workflows into parameterized reusable skills so ChatGPT authors less JSON and repeated engineering procedures become one compact invocation.

proposals.title: Guest-local browser automation
proposals.evidence: Public-repo investigation passed, but Gen2 still has no rendered browser/DOM workflow; web work is limited to HTTP/git/CLI.
proposals.expected_benefit: Enable rendered-site research and web testing entirely inside the isolated VM without widening host authority.

proposals.title: Richer transactional edit engine
proposals.evidence: Gen2 exact replacement and git patch operations passed, including deterministic mismatch rollback, but arbitrary source transforms still fall back to command/copy composition.
proposals.expected_benefit: Add AST-aware edits, multi-file transactions, preview/accept semantics, and stronger rollback without adding narrow MCP tools.

proposals.title: Parallel candidate experiment harness
proposals.evidence: The slowest Gen2 tasks were containment, bad-candidate recovery, restart verification, and candidate validation; current workflows execute sequentially.
proposals.expected_benefit: Run independent candidate/build/research experiments concurrently while preserving per-run audit and containment gates.

proposals.title: Failure recipe library + adaptive bounded retry
proposals.evidence: Gen2 recorded visible exact-replace failures and four bounded retries, while the only outer shell failure was the expected service-restart interruption.
proposals.expected_benefit: Promote recurring, well-understood transient failures into named bounded recovery recipes while keeping retries visible and finite.
